answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Every claim climbs the ocean of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the zenith re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, re-queued for a second panel. Reaching the vine of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
